blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Manases “Mans” Carpio, have more than 50 firearms registered under their names, a witness told the Senate impeachment court on Monday. Maj. Jerickson Sangalang of the Philippine National Police (PNP) Firearms and Explosives Office testified that Duterte alone has 22 firearms registered in her name. […]...
